messages.author: nora
messages.text: Proposal: add a kind field to LedgerEntry (payments, refunds, adjustments). Reporting currently infers kind from amount signs, which breaks on zero-amount adjustments.

messages.author: samir
messages.text:
Support this. Code sketch:
```
class LedgerEntry:
    kind: str = 'unknown'  # backfill default
```
Old entries read back as unknown, new ones stamped. Small migration.
